description: Every interval before 1970-01-01T00:00Z on which the UTC offset of the history this package ships for a zone name differs between tzdata 2025c and 2026f as released, from zdump -v on zic-compiled data (oracle.mjs). Entries with ownerDecision 'held back' do not ship: the package holds America/Yellowknife at tzdata 2025c by the owner's decision ('held', 'shipped'). Offsets in seconds east; intervals are [from, to) in UTC; from null means from the beginning of the zone's history. transitionsOnly, eraEnds and fromHistoryEnd list what moves without such an offset change; rows are 'UTC offset isdst abbreviation' (transitionsOnly) or 'UTC offsetBefore offsetAfter' (fromHistoryEnd).

shipped.description: What the package ships: tzdata 2026f with America/Yellowknife held at tzdata 2025c by the owner's decision. Names and intervals whose shipped offsets before 1970 move, the held name's excluded; every other name ships exactly 2026f's history (the held and 2026f builds compared name by name).

held.shipped: tzdata 2025c's history: 0 offset differences, 0 transition differences before 1970, the same local mean time era (none) and the same data form as tzdata 2025c

transitionsOnly.news: The backward-compatibility names EST5EDT, CST6CDT, MST7MDT, and PST8PDT now conform better to POSIX. For example, EST5EDT now always uses the abbreviation "EST" for standard time (now always 5 hours behind UT) and "EDT" for daylight saving time, whereas it formerly had different UT offsets before standard time was introduced and sometimes used abbreviations like "LMT", "EWT" and "EPT", all contrary to POSIX.
source: tzdata 2025c backzone lines 1840 to 1845: "Zone	EST5EDT		 -5:00	US	E%sT" and the same for CST6CDT, MST7MDT and PST8PDT, under rule US
tzdata 2025c northamerica line 180: "Rule	US	1945	only	-	Aug	14	23:00u	1:00	P # Peace" (War time W becomes Peace time P: a transition with no offset change)
tzdata 2026f backward lines 372 to 375: the same four zones under rule USback
tzdata 2026f backward line 335: "# To conform to POSIX, this copy uses D instead of W for War and P for Peace."
tzdata 2026f backward line 340: "Rule	USback	1945	only	-	Aug	14	23:00u	1:00	D # Peace" (D before and after, so zic records no transition)

eraEnds.news: Move Europe/Uzhgorod and Europe/Zaporozhye to 'backzone'; backward-compatibility links still work, albeit with different timestamps before October 1991.

fromHistoryEnd.news: Morocco plans to move back to permanent UTC, without daylight saving time transitions, on 2026-09-20 at 02:00. This also affects Western Sahara.
